notes: BlueprintsClient::list performs the authenticated GET /v1/blueprints and decodes the BlueprintListResponse body.
BlueprintListResponse models the blueprints array as Blueprint values.
Blueprint models resources and components as generic JsonObject maps rather than integer-valued maps from the OpenAPI schema.
DeviceCommand::Adopt emits the command tag and the shared optional single-or-batch target fields.
DeviceCommand::Attach emits the command tag and the shared optional single-or-batch target fields.
DeviceCommand::ChangeOwner emits the required command tag and target string.
DeviceCommand::CollectResources requires a resources object but leaves its OpenAPI numeric values as generic JSON values.
DeviceCommand::Configure emits the command tag and optional nullable mode string with the documented wire name.
DeviceCommand::DepositResources models the optional nullable resources object but leaves its OpenAPI numeric values as generic JSON values.
DeviceCommand::DequeuePrint emits the command tag and optional nullable integer index.
DeviceCommand::Detach emits the command tag and the shared optional single-or-batch target fields.
DeviceCommand::EnqueuePrint models the required device_type and all optional quantity, controller, flatpack, tags, and oncomplete fields.
DeviceCommand::Message emits required channel and text strings alongside the command tag.
The unit variants of DeviceCommand serialize as the command-only bodies required by NoParamSchema.
DeviceCommand::Prospect emits the command tag and optional nullable numeric direction array.
DeviceCommand::Release emits the command tag and the shared optional single-or-batch target fields.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI defines the required name property, while the rendered command example uses new_name (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/devices/command/index.md:107); the client serializes name.
DeviceCommand::Repair emits the command tag and optional nullable device and target strings.
DeviceCommand::Replicate emits required target and optional nullable name alongside the command tag.
DeviceCommand::Retarget emits the required command tag and resource_type string.
DeviceCommand::SetDirective models required directive plus nullable open-object configuration and notify fields.
DeviceCommand::SetWelcomeMessage emits the command tag and optional nullable message string.
DeviceCommand::StartMining emits required resource_type and optional nullable target alongside the command tag.
DeviceCommand::StellarCensus emits the command tag and optional nullable integer page and per_page fields.
DeviceCommand::Stow emits the command tag and optional nullable target string.
DeviceCommand::Triangulate emits required signature and numeric target array alongside the command tag.
